name: Draden “Dradie” McPhail (Dunbar)
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
Ancestry.com, U.S., Social Security Applications and Claims Index, 1936–2007
notes: One of the four McPhail girls born in Memphis; married (surname Dunbar) and stayed in the Arkansas, Oklahoma and Kansas area when the family went west. [Family research emails, email 48, 49]
Her full name appears as Dradie Susan Dunbar in a Social Security claim that names her parents John B. McPhail and Ellen R. Ball.
